dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The primary 'O' shaped structures on the mid-dorsal surface exhibit irregular, granular outer perimeters. The pixel gradient transitions sharply from the dark charcoal background to a bright, light-gray ring, enclosing a dark-valued interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity blobs across the mid-dorsal region; conversely, a high concentration of small, high-intensity pixel clusters is present in the posterior-lateral zone near the flipper.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent annuli on the lateral flank form an acute scalene triangle. A larger configuration involving four annuli along the dorsal ridge forms a slightly curved linear chain.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible posterior flipper displays five high-contrast, dark vertical bands (digit-like structures) that form a distinct, parallel-aligned serrated pattern.
